title: Per-release scan evidence bundle
description: For each release: commit and artifact hashes, each scanner's name, version, rule set and database version, scope and exclusions, coverage, findings, suppressions, gate outcome and reviewer identity, as required by the Secure Construction Standard assurance deliverables.
producer: Praxis (CI workflow and provenance tooling exists; no security scanning step is configured)

title: Scanner coverage matrix
description: Matrix of repositories, services, artifact types and languages against each scanner class (SAST, SCA, secrets, DAST, IaC, container), with uncovered cells listed explicitly.

title: Scanner validation report
description: Per scanner release: benchmark suites used (NIST SARD/Juliet, OWASP Benchmark where applicable, Echelon F# fixtures and holdout cases), precision, recall, false positive and false negative rates by weakness class, bypass and mutation results, and limitations.
producer: not yet assigned (Secure Construction Standard proposes Dokimos; Dokimos is a code-quality system and its scanner benchmarking role is unverified)
notes: Benchmarking is not accreditation or government endorsement (Secure Construction Standard).

title: Secret detection and response record
description: Each detected secret: location, detection time, blocking or post-hoc, rotation and revocation times, usage investigation result, and closure.

title: Suppression and false-positive register
description: Each suppression: rule, location, justification, approver distinct from author (and never an AI agent), expiry and re-review result.

title: Customer scan summary
description: Signed summary per production release: counts by severity and scanner, open critical findings, coverage, gate outcome, labeled as first-party evidence and tied to the release hash.
producer: not yet assigned (Folio is a candidate renderer for reports)
